notes: CDRH Quality Management System Regulation (21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485) letter for a Doppler-device firm: undocumented design change expanding the Bidop 3's indication for use to fetal monitoring without a new 510(k) evaluation, inadequate fetal-risk analysis for the Bidop 3 and Bidop 7, insufficient supplier (contract manufacturer) controls, and complaint-handling failures (RGA forms not evaluated as complaints) illustrated with Bidop 7, Bidop 3, a CRP-20H cardiovascular probe, and an Aneroid Sphygmomanometer. Products use the shortest exact-casing span (e.g., 'Bidop 3' rather than the longer 'Bidop 3 Doppler'). No FEI is stated in this device letter (only a CMS case number). fei is null.
